title: The appointed time and the removal of the boundary
english: But when the end of God's appointed time arrives, and the boundary that now restrains the lawless one is removed, once its purpose is fulfilled, then the lawless one will be revealed immediately and without any delay.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 85/160; Fragmentum in epistulam ii ad Thessalonicenses (Khazarzar) via Khazarzar (Fragmentum in epistulam ii ad Thessalonicenses.pdf).
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No copyrighted English base. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.
Khazarzar research-footer lines stripped; body not truncated at mid-text footer.
Corpus-wide Rank-1 Evagrius PG 40; ANF-covered stays densify-lane (Evagrius not ANF). Skip De oratione (Nilus/PD English tradition).
Not ANF body for this Greek; Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify (not Cyril of Alexandria Matthew). Nemesius/Macarius densify-lane.

orientation: Gennadius is commenting on 2 Thessalonians 2:7-8, explaining when and how the lawless one will be revealed.
